additional_control_instruction_proposal.candidate: Initially use END as the only explicit terminal/drain control instruction; no FENCE, LOOP, JUMP, standalone bank invalidation opcode or double-buffered command memory.
additional_control_instruction_proposal.local_dependency_rule: The current-PC scoreboard waits for matched completion and exclusive ownership release on operand banks.
DDR_alias_hazard_example: DMA_STORE local bank A to DDR region R
DMA_LOAD overlapping DDR region R to distinct local bank B
additional_control_instruction_proposal.DDR_alias_hazard_reason: Distinct local banks do not create a scoreboard dependency; request issue order alone does not prove DDR write-to-read visibility.
alias_ordering_candidate: Reuse a common local bank when valid for capacity/layout and lifetime, so its ownership enforces completion before dependent issue
Otherwise split after the store at END; PS waits for successful DONE before publishing the dependent load chunk
additional_control_instruction_proposal.compiler_requirement: Analyze explicit DMA address ranges and read/write ordering; reject or split unsafe programs rather than relying on implicit DDR hazards.
additional_control_instruction_proposal.loop_distinction: GEMM internally iterates over agreed local-bank compute tiles, K16 steps and group128 processing; PS emits explicit DDR-residency tiles. These do not require ISA LOOP/JUMP.
additional_control_instruction_proposal.cost: Additional chunk boundaries can increase PS publication overhead; this must be reported in end-to-end latency. A future FENCE or double buffer requires measured benefit and user discussion.
additional_control_instruction_proposal.actual_model_schedule_and_command_count: pending bank inventory/layout and runtime lowering
additional_control_instruction_proposal.scope_change_rule: Any future FENCE/LOOP/JUMP/double buffer addition requires design discussion, updated contracts and affected validation.

additional_control_instruction_decision.DDR_alias_ordering: Use a common operand bank ownership dependency where valid for capacity/layout; otherwise end the store chunk and wait for successful DONE before publishing dependent loads.
additional_control_instruction_decision.PS_generator_obligation: Validate DMA read/write address-range dependencies and split unsafe schedules; request issue order alone is insufficient for different-bank DDR aliases.
additional_control_instruction_decision.GEMM_internal_iterations: local-bank K16/N4 compute loops and group128 processing, not ISA control loops
additional_control_instruction_decision.PS_residency_iterations: explicit instruction records in END-terminated program chunks
additional_control_instruction_decision.performance_accounting: Include all chunk load/publication and boundary costs in end-to-end latency.
additional_control_instruction_decision.future_changes: Discuss necessity/cost and update affected contracts and evidence before adding control instructions or buffering.

proposed_additional_modes.operation: Reconstruct explicitly DMA-loaded shared embedding W4 codes and FP32 group scales to BF16 embedding activations. Runtime PS supplies token-derived DMA addresses only.
Round completed FP32 GEMM result banks to BF16 activation banks using the agreed final rounding policy.
Copy/extract/pack head and tensor tiles between distinct logical bank handles according to an explicitly defined tensor layout. No raw local address/offset tensor operand.

vector_conversion_layout_proposal.purpose: Ensure embedding reconstruction, numeric conversion and required head/tile movement are explicitly lowered and executed in PL.
vector_conversion_layout_proposal.module_boundary_change: Add modes to the agreed shared vector executor, not a new dedicated compute executor.
vector_conversion_layout_proposal.transpose_or_GQA_replication_materializa: not_assumed; assess supported GEMM layouts and reuse before selecting extra movement
